name: plus-2-subagents
description: Same tier assignment as Plus, but every fan-out is capped at two concurrent subagents.
notes: Set the Host subagent setting maxActiveSubagents to 2 to match; the kit cannot write Host settings for you.
Execution runs at low effort: DSH's ladder is off | low | high | max, so the upstream 'medium' execution tier is expressed as low.
Choose this for a tight budget on well-specified work.
